landing_page:
# Turn client intake emails into one clean workflow

Formflow gives independent consultants and small service teams a structured intake page, automatic follow-up, and a live status board without forcing clients to create an account.

## Stop rebuilding the same intake process for every client

Create a reusable form from a template or start from scratch. Conditional questions collect the right details for each service. New responses become organized client records, attachments stay with the request, and missing answers trigger an automatic reminder.

## See what needs attention

The status board shows every request as New, Waiting on Client, Ready, or Complete. Assign an owner, add an internal note, and send a client update from the same record. Clients receive a secure link that works without a password.

## Start in minutes

Import an existing questionnaire, publish a branded intake link, and embed it on your site. Formflow includes templates for project briefs, discovery calls, onboarding, document collection, and change requests.

Formflow costs $29 per month after a 14-day trial. A card is required to start the trial. Cancel from account settings at any time. The plan includes unlimited forms, 500 active client records, two team members, and email support.

Start your 14-day trial and publish your first intake flow today.

ads.headline: Stop chasing missing client details.
ads.message: A vague client request should not turn into another email thread. Formflow gives clients one secure link to provide the details and attachments you need—no account required. When an answer is missing, send an automatic reminder and see every request on a live status board. Start your 14-day trial today.
ads.visual: 25-second vertical motion video. Open on a vague email reading, “I’ll send the remaining details soon,” beside a request card with blank fields. A Formflow missing-answer reminder appears. Show the client opening a secure link on a phone, completing the missing field without signing in, and submitting it. Finish on a live status board with columns labeled New, Waiting on Client, Ready, and Complete. On-screen captions read: “One secure link.” “Automatic reminders.” “Know what needs attention.” End card: “14-day trial.”
